instructions.content: NEVER hardcode personal access tokens in scripts; read from environment variables or a secrets manager instead.
NEVER assume a single page has all the results; loop on the `X-Next-Page` response header until it is empty.
NEVER call the GitLab API without respecting rate limits; check for `429` responses and back off, honoring `Retry-After`.
NEVER use the API `v3` endpoint path; GitLab removed v3 in GitLab 11.0, use `v4`.
Validate the shape of the API response before processing it, since GitLab can return HTTP 200 with an error object in the body.
Treat `System` (bot vs human) and `Type` (DiffNote vs comment) as two independent classification axes; do not conflate them.
Re-fetch rather than cache when the analysis is time-sensitive, since comments can be edited or deleted between fetches.
URL-encode nested group paths, replacing `/` with `%2F`, when building GitLab API project paths.
Use `jq` for JSON parsing; never grep on raw API JSON.
Handle UTC timestamps with proper timezone conversion when displaying them to users in another timezone.
